SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No.
Special Branch S. 4 XXXXXX
REPORT
Date November 13, 19 33.

Subject (in full) Dr. J.P. Ryabine.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the Officer i/c Special Branch
memo regarding Dr. J.P. Ryabine, enquiries show that he is a
Jugoslavian subject, born on September 25, 1887 at Belgrade,
Serbia. He claimed to have graduated from the Kazan Univer-
sity, Russia, in 1912. It is known that Dr. Ryabine partici-
pated in the Civil War in Siberia, serving in the ranks of the
White Russian Army of Ataman Semenov in Trans-baikal Province.
In 1922 he arrived at Shanghai from North China. From 1924
until 1930 he was employed as an inspector of the Service
Sanitaire (Health Department) of the French Municipal Council.
He lost his position when a new head of this department was
appointed and many employees were obliged to resign. Since
his resignation, Dr. Ryabine has been in private practice.
At present Dr. Ryabine has an office at No.416 Szechuen Road
Room 72.

It is reported that Dr. Ryabine is a frequenter of
gambling dens. At times he has to depend upon his winnings
to cover his expenses. On one occasion he had some trouble
in the Polish Club when it was discovered that the game at
his table was not being played above board. Dr. Ryabine is
living in an expensive style much beyond the income from his
practice as a doctor. It is rumoured that he is on friendly
terms with a certain Dr. Kurth Barth, a German (File D.4431)
who was arrested on January 12, 1933 at 1/14 Vong Ching Lao,
Nantao, on a charge of running a large morphine plant and was
sentenced to one year's imprisonment and to pay a fine of $3,000.
Enquiries made in connection with this case revealed that
one L. Establier, proprietor of the Pharmacie Modern, No.455
Avenue Joffre, was the partner in this business and that Dr.

档案号
特别支部 S. 4 XXXXXX
报告
日期 1933年11月13日。

主题（全称） J.P. Ryabine 博士。

制作人 D.S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人 [签名]

关于特别支部负责人就 J.P. Ryabine 博士所发的备忘录，经查询显示，其为南斯拉夫籍臣民，1887年9月25日出生于塞尔维亚贝尔格莱德。他声称于1912年毕业于俄国喀山大学。已知 Ryabine 博士曾参与西伯利亚内战，在外贝加尔省阿塔曼·谢苗诺夫（Ataman Semenov）的白俄军队中服役。1922年，他从华北抵达上海。1924年至1930年间，他受雇于法公董局卫生局（Service Sanitaire）担任稽查员。当该部门任命新任主管且许多雇员被迫辞职时，他失去了职位。自辞职以来，Ryabine 博士一直从事私人执业。目前，Ryabine 博士在四川路416号72室设有诊所。

据报，Ryabine 博士常出入赌博场所。有时他不得不依靠赌资来支付开销。有一次，在波兰俱乐部发生了一些麻烦，当时发现他所在牌桌上的游戏存在作弊行为。Ryabine 博士生活奢华，远超其作为医生的执业收入。有谣言称，他与一名德国人 Kurth Barth 博士（档案号 D.4431）关系友好，后者于1933年1月12日在南市翁正老路1/14号因经营大型吗啡制造厂被捕，并被判处一年监禁及罚款3,000美元。对此案进行的调查揭示，位于霞飞路455号现代药房（Pharmacie Modern）的业主 L. Establier 是此业务的合伙人，且 Dr.

Ryabine also has a certain interest in the undertaking (File D 443/1).
During the past few months Dr. Ryabine appears to
have been in great financial difficulties. He borrowed a few hun-
dred dollars from the China Finance Corporation and later he
secured a loan of $800 from the Thriftcorp Bank, 8 Kiukiang
Road and repaid the amount. On October 7, 1935 on the orders
of the Chinese Civil Court in French Concession Dr. Ryabine's
property in his flat at No.966 Avenue Joffre, Apartment 17 was
ordered to be sold by Auction to pay a debt of $267.80 (house
rent) to the Foncier et Immobiliere de Chine, No.9 Avenue Edward
VII. This auction, however, was not held as Dr. Ryabine had
already removed from the house.
About a month ago, Dr. Ryabine joined a recently
opened Ambulatory of Specialist Doctors (a clinic where moderate
fees are charged) at No.610 Avenue Joffre, Flat 4. This esta-
blishment according to report was opened by Doctor Perevozsky,
a Russian Jewess, and a group of other doctors. It is being
financed by one Mrs. Chen, a Chinese. Among the doctors em-
ployed in this institution are Dr. Osvald Glatz, German, sus-
pected of being a Soviet Agent (File I.O.7860), and Dr. A.
Schoenfeld, Hungarian, (File D.5189).
Dr. Ryabine has married twice. His first wife,
Vaentina Vladimirovna nee Kutuzoff who was born in 1895 in
Central Russia, was a nurse by occupation and took part in the
Civil War in Russia. She died on July 26, 1933 at Shanghai.
Dr. Ryabine's second wife, whose maiden name was Alexandra
Andreevna Voronin, was born on August 20, 1905 at Sevastopol,
South Russia. Her first husband was a Norwegian Captain named
Kisling. From his second wife Dr. Ryabine has a son named

Ryabine 在该企业中亦拥有某种利益（档案号 D 443/1）。
在过去几个月里，Ryabine 博士似乎陷入了严重的财务困境。他从中法银行（China Finance Corporation）借了数百美元，随后又从九江路8号的 thriftcorp 银行（Thriftcorp Bank）获得了一笔800美元的贷款并予以偿还。1935年10月7日，根据法租界中国民事法院的命令，Ryabine 博士位于霞飞路966号17室公寓内的财产被下令拍卖，以偿还欠爱德华七世路9号中国地产信贷公司（Foncier et Immobiliere de Chine）的267.80美元债务（房租）。然而，由于 Ryabine 博士已搬离该住所，此次拍卖并未举行。
大约一个月前，Ryabine 博士加入了一家新开设的专科医生巡回诊疗所（一家收取适度费用的诊所），地址为霞飞路610号4室。据报道，该机构由俄罗斯犹太裔女医生 Perevozsky 博士及其他一群医生开办。其资金由一位陈姓中国女士提供。在该机构受聘的医生中包括德国人 Osvald Glatz 博士，他被怀疑是苏联特工（档案号 I.O.7860），以及匈牙利人 A. Schoenfeld 博士（档案号 D.5189）。
Ryabine 博士结过两次婚。他的第一任妻子 Vaentina Vladimirovna，娘家姓 Kutuzoff，1895年出生于俄罗斯中部，职业为护士，曾参加俄国内战。她于1933年7月26日在上海去世。Ryabine 博士的第二任妻子，娘家姓 Alexandra Andreevna Voronin，1905年8月20日出生于俄罗斯南部的塞瓦斯托波尔。她的第一任丈夫是一位名叫 Kisling 的挪威船长。Ryabine 博士与第二任妻子育有一子，名为
